name: index_correlated_breakout_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, whenever a bar closes above the running intraday session high, it signals that institutional VWAP-benchmarked algorithms that were patiently accumulating on earlier dips have finally absorbed all intraday supply — their execution models flip from 'passive fill' to 'active momentum' mode. This creates a cascade of order flow that typically extends 15-25 NIFTY spot points over the next 30-90 seconds. The edge is highest when: (1) the breakout occurs above VWAP — confirming the institutional side of the ledger is net-long for the session — and (2) a 1-minute momentum buildup precedes the new high, distinguishing a sustained institutional push from a retail spike that fails within 2-3 bars. Session-high breakouts that occur mid-session (after 09:30, when all opening range noise has cleared) carry stronger institutional weight than ORB breakouts because they overcome all intraday supply that accumulated post-open.

indicators.name: session_high
indicators.formula: running max(high) since 09:15 IST, resets each day
indicators.purpose: Cumulative measure from session open — no scaling needed. Tracks the highest intraday high seen so far today. Signal fires when current close exceeds the PREVIOUS bar's session high, confirming a new intraday extreme has been set.

indicators.name: session_low
indicators.formula: running min(low) since 09:15 IST, resets each day
indicators.purpose: Symmetric to session_high for bearish breakdowns. Cumulative minimum, resets daily.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative sum(typical_price * volume) / cumulative sum(volume) from 09:15 IST, resets daily
indicators.purpose: Cumulative — no scaling. VWAP alignment (close > VWAP for longs, < VWAP for shorts) confirms institutional net direction for the session. Replaces the original strategy's 'dual VWAP alignment' (stock VWAP + index VWAP both on same side) with a single NIFTY VWAP, since the stock component is gone.

indicators.name: momentum_12
indicators.purpose: 12 bars = 60 seconds. Detects whether price was BUILDING toward the new session high over the preceding minute (sustained institutional push) vs spiking up in 1-2 bars (retail noise). A 60s window is the minimum to distinguish momentum from a spike at 5s resolution. We are trading the continuation at 30-120s hold; the trigger must match that cadence.

indicators.name: vol_avg_120
indicators.purpose: 120 bars = 10 minutes. Volume ratio = current_volume / vol_avg_120. Confirms institutional participation at the breakout bar. 10-minute baseline is long enough to capture the current session's volume regime (versus an opening rush) but short enough to adapt to time-of-day. The original required volume > 1.5x SMA(20) on 1-min bars; at 5s, 120 bars (10 min) provides an equivalent baseline.

conditions: close > session_high[t-1] — new intraday session high made on this bar
close > vwap — above session average price (institutional net-long bias)
momentum_12 > 0.05% — 1-minute bullish momentum buildup preceding the breakout
volume_ratio > 1.3x — above-average volume confirming institutional participation
vix < 22 — not in panic/volatility squeeze regime where breakouts fail faster
buy_ce.confirmation: All five conditions must be true simultaneously; no look-ahead

conditions: close < session_low[t-1] — new intraday session low made on this bar
close < vwap — below session average price (institutional net-short bias)
momentum_12 < -0.05% — 1-minute bearish momentum buildup preceding the breakdown
volume_ratio > 1.3x — above-average volume confirming institutional selling
vix < 22 — not in panic regime (extreme VIX means fills become unreliable)

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option pts = ~10 NIFTY spot pts at ATM delta ~0.5. Session high/low breakouts that are genuine continue without retracing 10 spot pts; a 10-pt retrace within 30s means the breakout is a false one and the institutional push has stalled. At the 30-120s hold, losing 10 spot pts invalidates the thesis.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option pts = ~16 NIFTY spot pts. Session-high expansions on NIFTY typically extend 15-25 spot pts in the first 30-90s when institutional algorithms are driving. 16 pts is the lower end of that range (conservative capture), giving 1:1.6 risk-reward vs the 5-pt stop.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 14:30 IST (870 minutes) — entries restricted to 09:30-14:30 IST; 120s max hold exits by 14:32

filters.vix_filter: VIX < 22 — breakouts in panic markets (VIX > 22) fail rapidly as mean-reversion algorithms overwhelm momentum
filters.time_filter: 09:30-14:30 IST — skip first 15 min of pre-open noise; stop entries at 14:30 so 120s max hold exits by 14:32
filters.trend_filter: close > VWAP for CE entries, close < VWAP for PE entries
filters.spread_filter: N/A — limit order execution, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — session high/low breakout is a well-known pattern; edge depends on strict multi-condition confirmation reducing false entries

adaptation_notes: Original required trading individual NIFTY-200 stocks and checking for SYNCHRONIZED stock + index session high breakouts — the 'dual confirmation' was stock-level + index-level. This cannot be replicated without a stock universe. Adaptation: trade NIFTY index directly, replacing the 'dual confirmation' with 3 independent confirmations (VWAP alignment, 1-min momentum buildup, volume surge) that together provide equivalent false-signal filtering. The session_high/low concept is preserved but now applies to NIFTY itself rather than to individual stocks. Key change: we trade all session long (not just opening), consistent with the original's 09:30-14:30 window (also not ORB-constrained). Volume filter uses 10-min rolling baseline instead of 20-bar SMA on 1-min bars. VIX filter kept from original (VIX < 25 → VIX < 22 for slightly stricter regime filtering on index options).
weaknesses: Session high/low breakouts on NIFTY fire only 2-5 times per day on average; some days produce zero signals
In strong trending days, the first session high breakout can be at 09:20 (before our 09:30 start), causing missed entry on the best trending day setups
Volume ratio threshold is sensitive to time-of-day patterns — mid-session volume is lower than opening, so same threshold may be too strict at 13:00 vs too loose at 09:35
